verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents its own way to connect external tools: MCP server configurations, both programmatic and file-based. That is a plausible route to workflow tools, but the evidence never shows actual Jira, Slack, or Google Drive integrations. Custom tools are a developer building block and earn no credit on their own. missing for 10: named first-party or documented integrations with Jira/Slack/Google Drive, documentation on using MCP connections to pull workflow-tool context, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: Programmatic MCP server configs, merged with file-based configs
